participants.note: Concept ACKed the initial commit and suggested a naming nanonit
walked through the server state transitions and zero-window probing to verify understanding of the bug and test failure
Approach ACKed keeping request processing strictly serial and proposed an alternative socket timeout approach for the test

support.reason: in order to keep request processing strictly serial, as intended in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35735#issue-4901039304, it makes sense to stop pipelining requests or reading requests ahead while one is still in flight

result.notes: No reviewers raised objections against merging. The PR was moved to draft by the author due to performance concerns (50ms added to RPC calls) and doubts about whether the underlying issue warrants server-side throttling changes.
